subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 4 – Lesson 6: English in action (Introducing family and friends)
outcomes: I can introduce someone: This is my sister. Her name's Jane.
I can say Nice to meet you and Nice to meet you, too.
I can write and act out an introduction.

tf.s: We use Her name's … for a girl.
tf.why: Yes! Her is for a girl.

tf.s: We use His name's … for a boy.
tf.why: Great! His is for a boy.

tf.s: This is my brother. Her name's Ali.
tf.why: Ali is a boy: His name's Ali.

tf.s: When we meet someone new, we say Nice to meet you.
tf.why: Well done! That is a kind greeting.

tf.s: The answer to Nice to meet you is Goodbye.
tf.why: We answer: Nice to meet you, too.

tf.s: We say This is my … to introduce someone.
Her name's Muna. Muna is a girl.
tf.why: Great! Her is for a girl.

tf.s: His name's Ahmed. Ahmed is a girl.
tf.why: His is for a boy, so Ahmed is a boy.

tf.s: Nice to meet you, too means I am sad.
tf.why: It means I am happy to meet you too.

tf.s: In the dialogue, Jane is Kim's sister.
tf.why: Jane is the speaker's sister; the speaker introduces her to Kim.

boxes.q: This is my sister. ___ name's Jane.
boxes.why: Jane is a girl: Her name's Jane.

boxes.q: This is my brother. ___ name's Ali.
boxes.why: Ali is a boy: His name's Ali.
We reply: Nice to meet you, too.

boxes.q: You meet a new friend. You say:
boxes.why: We say Nice to meet you.
This is my … introduces a person.
Ahmed is a boy: His name's Ahmed.
Muna is a girl: Her name's Muna.

boxes.q: Hello, Jane. Nice to meet you. Jane says:
boxes.why: Jane replies: Nice to meet you, too.

boxes.q: Write: It's my ___. (a picture of a grandad)

mcq.q: What do we say when we meet someone new?
mcq.why: Nice to meet you is polite.

mcq.q: Which word do we use for a girl's name?
mcq.why: Her name's … is for a girl.

mcq.q: Which word do we use for a boy's name?
mcq.why: His name's … is for a boy.

mcq.q: How do we introduce a person?

o: This is my brother. His name's Sami.
This is my brother. Her name's Sami.
This is my sister. His name's Sami.
mcq.why: Brother is a boy: His name's Sami.

mcq.q: Your friend says: Nice to meet you. What do you say?
mcq.why: We reply: Nice to meet you, too.

mcq.q: Complete: This is my sister. ___ name's Jane.
mcq.why: Sister is a girl: Her name's Jane.

o: This is my sister. His name's Muna.
This is my sister. Her name's Muna.
This is my brother. His name's Ali.
mcq.why: Sister is a girl, so we say Her name's.

mcq.q: Why do we say Nice to meet you?
o: To be kind and polite to someone new
mcq.why: It shows we are happy to meet them.

mcq.q: Put the dialogue in order: (a) Nice to meet you, too. (b) This is my sister. (c) Hello! Nice to meet you.
mcq.why: First introduce, then greet, then reply.
